Host.ManagementPort: <the port of the health endpoints, other than the public port>

Idempotency.KeyRetention: <a time span of at least 24 hours, d.hh:mm:ss>

RateLimiting.PermitLimit: <requests per user in each window, a positive number>

InvitationAccept.PermitLimit: <invitation accepts per user in each window, a positive number>

AuthorizedParties: <origin of a client allowed to use the API>

KnownProxies: <IP address of a trusted reverse proxy>

ErrorTracking.Dsn: <optional: the error tracker's DSN; without it no error is sent>
ErrorTracking.Release: <optional: the commit of the build; the container image sets it>

Heartbeat.Url: <optional, a secret: the worker's heartbeat URL; without it no heartbeat is sent>
Heartbeat.Interval: <optional: the time between two heartbeat calls, hh:mm:ss>

ConnectionStrings.Messaging: <optional: the application role's direct connection, when Database goes through a pooler in transaction mode>
ConnectionStrings.Migrations: <the owner role's direct connection, given only to the migrate command, never to a running process>
ConnectionStrings.Cache: <optional: the shared cache's connection, host:port,password=...; without it every access check reads the database>

RootEmails: <email address of a root system admin>

Clerk.SecretKey: <the identity provider's Backend API secret key>
Clerk.BackendApiUrl: <the identity provider's Backend API URL, ending in />

Invitations.AcceptUrl: <URL of the frontend page that accepts invitations>
Invitations.Lifetime: <a time span of at least one day, d.hh:mm:ss>

Tenants.PurgeWarningLead: <a positive time span shorter than ReopenPeriod, d.hh:mm:ss>

Resend.ApiKey: <Resend API key; set together with From, it sends real email, in Development too>
Resend.From: <sender on a domain verified at Resend, for example App <no-reply@example.com>>

OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT: <optional: the OTLP collector's URL; without it no telemetry is sent>
AllowedHosts: <host names the API answers to, or * for any>
